subject.title: Gateway becomes slow or times out under multi-session / multi-agent load

question: Should this stay as the broad canonical Gateway liveness tracker until a current live trace exists, or should maintainers split the remaining work into narrower handler/storage issues now?
rationale: Partial fixes landed in several adjacent paths, but choosing the next useful scope requires maintainer judgment about live proof, transcript-retention policy, Gateway handler ownership, and whether narrower open issues already own parts of the work.

options.title: Keep Canonical Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad live-repro tracker until v2026.6.11/current-main evidence shows whether logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.compact, sessions.list, or channel delivery remains the bottleneck.

options.title: Split Measured Bottlenecks
options.body: Create or promote narrower issues only after a fresh trace identifies a specific remaining slow handler or storage policy gap.

options.title: Close To Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide the remaining symptoms are fully covered by open narrow trackers such as transcript caps or Dashboard polling.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad live-repro tracker until v2026.6.11/current-main evidence shows whether logs.tail, chat.history, sessions.compact, sessions.list, or channel delivery remains the bottleneck.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline and current inspected Gateway/session history make this the best available routing candidate for deciding broad Gateway liveness scope.
